parsed.reason: Hale returned no picks, even though its own notes held at least three valid finds from the venues' own pages. Pointe-à-Callière's official page gives a holiday schedule covering December 27–30 (regular hours, closed only Dec 25 and Jan 1) and free entry for children 0–4. The Montréal Science Centre's own visitor page gives regular opening hours with nothing to suggest a closure in that window. The Espace pour la vie calendrier (Ville de Montréal) lists Biodôme exhibits running through January 3, 2027. Nothing was invented, from an aggregator or term-based, but returning nothing when open, drop-in venues were in hand is a substantial failure to deliver.
